te: Henry VI, the son and heir of the Holy Roman Emperor Frederick I, marries Constance of Sicily.

de: Henry VI, the son and heir of the Holy Roman Emperor Frederick I, marries Constance of Sicily.

dz: 格奥尔根伯格条约(Georgenberg Contract):奥托卡尔四世,施蒂利亚公爵和利奥波德五世,奥地利公爵签署一项遗产协议,奥托卡尔在协议中将他的德行给予利奥波德和他的儿子弗雷德里克,规定奥地利和施蒂利亚从此不再分裂.
de: Georgenberg Pact: Ottokar IV, Duke of Styria and Leopold V, Duke of Austria sign a heritage agreement in which Ottokar gives his duchy to Leopold and to his son Frederick under the stipulation that Austria and Styria would henceforth remain undivided.
